🚨 HMPV🚨
HMPV - Human Metapneumovirus .

Symptoms - cough, fever, & shortness of breath, with potential complications like bronchitis and pneumonia.

Cases of HMPV had been reported in 2011-12 in the U.S., Canada, and Europe.
